description.en: The draft consolidated into a formal standard: English normative, with a Chinese version and the standard word list; the web pages, PDFs and Markdown are all built from one source.

The runtime, the SPICE and Spectre adapters, the renderer and the rnl command; the web viewer goes online and the Windows desktop viewer 0.1.0 is released. They open a netlist with RNL and draw what has coordinates.
The core as WebAssembly is published to npm as a preview: @rich-netlist/runtime, under the tag next.

The solver must write back every decision it makes, so that a viewer that does not solve draws what it drew: objects that no name reaches have numbers, and the routes of automatic wires are written back. The standard series 0.3 spells its names out in full; the formal standard comes with a Chinese version, and files of 0.2 still read.

title.en: The RNL skill package and the page for agents

description.en: A skill package for AI agents (Agent Skills format): a short guide, a reference to the standard packages, notes on the tools and examples; this site has a page for agents and an llms.txt.
The desktop viewer edits the text and saves it, solves and shows the result as a preview, and lists the objects that are not drawn; it reads files of language 0.3.
eda-style provides EDA schematic symbols and styling; the SKY130 package is renamed pdk-sky130. Extensions are included explicitly, while the core bundles only the standard packages.
@rich-netlist/runtime publishes 0.1.0-preview.13 and preview.14, continuing to distribute the WebAssembly core under next.
The web viewer gains a canvas-only embedding mode. Other pages can open netlists, navigate levels, fit the drawing and change its background through messages without reloading.

title.en: Site navigation, logo and package gallery

description.en: The site gains shared navigation and sidebars, package groups for standard series, extensions and PDKs, an interactive circuit logo, and an origin toggle in the gallery.
eda-symbol supplies 137 schematic symbols; the independent eda-style styles standard, custom and EDA symbols. Either package can be used on its own.
Optional public packages move to rnl-packages. The viewers and site fetch versioned files from its catalog and verify SHA256; the standard packages remain built into the core.

title.en: Open the complete Viewer from another site

description.en: The complete Viewer and embedded mode share an import API for netlists, URLs and exact public-package versions. Other sites can open or reuse a Viewer tab and cancel superseded imports.
The Viewer adds English and Chinese UI, Auto Include, compilation and drawing caches, and background preloading; @rich-netlist/runtime publishes 0.1.0-preview.15.
Planned: symbols chosen by the number of terminals; the new @SOLVER-CONFIG.

Planned: the names of the standard package move out of the solver into its configuration, so that in a file of 0.3 the objectives for current direction, ground direction and signal flow have something to act on.
